# RC-09 District network and thermal storage
**Feeds:** DB-31/32 return temperatures, TL-23 pipe_heat_loss, GM-09 ThermalStorage, dispatch rules.
**Verification status:** values from Guidebook Ch10/12, Danfoss/Thisted, Shallow DHC review, WEC, TU Delft/RTES papers.

## Benchmarks (sanity)
- NL consumer heat price cap 2026 (ACM maximum variable tariff): 40.97 €/GJ incl. VAT = **33.86 €/GJ excl. VAT = 121.9 €/MWh_th ≈ 138 $/MWh_th**; a competitive LCOH must sit below this (ACM, "ACM stelt maximale warmtetarieven 2026 vast", 5 Dec 2025).
- Chiller plant installed costs: water-cooled centrifugal 740–760 $2022/ton (≈ 210–216 $/kW_c) for 400–600 ton units (US EIA, *Updated Buildings Sector Appliance and Equipment Costs*, Mar 2023, p. 125); single-stage LiBr absorption 1,800–2,300 $/ton installed for 1,320–440 ton (≈ 512–654 $/kW_c), equipment only 820–2,010 $/ton (US DOE AMO, *Absorption Chillers for CHP Systems*, DOE/EE-1608, May 2017, Table 3 p. 4). Use to sanity-check the RC-05 1986 functions × CEPCI 2.5.
- Gippsland GRAC LCOH 19.16 AUD/GJ (gas 31); SGIL 16.81; capacity factor drives LCOH; shared networks −12 %.
- WVU heating + absorption cooling: $40–43/MWh_th full retrofit (2012 $), $18–22 hot-water case.
- NREL desalination: new wells LCOH US$0.010–0.014/kWh_th (2014 $).
- World Energy Council: district-energy cost structure ≈ 75 % capital, 15 % O&M, 10 % ancillary energy.
